content: rusqlite 0.40 (from 0.32): breaking changes concentrated in the virtual-table (VTab) API — VTab macros replaced by constructors, VTab::best_index/connect/create signatures changed across several point releases. Verified locally: agent-install/omni-agent-rs's only consumer (src/buffer.rs) uses only Connection/params/Connection::open() — no VTab usage; cargo check passes clean at rusqlite 0.40.1 (libsqlite3-sys 0.38.1) with bundled feature preserved.
